description: Source code implementing constraint parsing and management for XML-based constraints, including functions for parsing time constraints, freeing constraints, and parsing complex constraint structures with logical operators.

methods.name: parse_time_constraint
methods.description: Parses a time constraint XML node, extracting start and end times, and appends the constraint to the list.

methods.name: icrule_free_constraint
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a constraint, including child constraints and time constraints.

methods.name: icrule_parse_constraint
methods.description: Recursively parses XML nodes to build a constraint structure with logical operators and time constraints.
